title: Google built a "Mirror Dimension", an isolated internet with simulated environments like social media and banking dashboards, to test AI browsing agents (Lily Hay Newman/Wired)
summary: Lily Hay Newman / Wired: Google built a “Mirror Dimension”, an isolated internet with simulated environments like social media and banking dashboards, to test AI browsing agents — The company's alternate-universe internet serves as a massive sandbox that allowed the Chrome team to properly train the AI browsing agents …
